summary: Tested START and END ride button functionality. The bugs were: 1) 'Course déjà en statut: unknown' error - FIXED in previous iteration by main agent. 2) Body stream read errors during fetch - caused by test data having explicit `started_at: null` which fails MongoDB atomic update check. Full workflow (ASSIGNED → IN_PROGRESS → DRIVER_COMPLETED) verified working correctly with fresh courses.

minor.issue: Atomic update check `started_at: {$exists: false}` fails if course has `started_at: null` - returns 409. This is by design but can confuse testing with manually created test data.

critical_code_review_comments: handleStartRide/handleEndRide now use inline res.json() instead of safeReadJson helper for clearer error handling
409 response handling correctly reads current_status from response body
Status badge updates properly after successful START/END actions
Toast messages show 'Course démarrée !' and 'Course terminée !' correctly
React StrictMode causes double fetch calls in development - harmless but visible in logs
context_for_next_testing_agent: START and END ride buttons verified working. For future test data: ensure test courses don't have `started_at: null` set explicitly - the field should not exist for fresh ASSIGNED courses. The MongoDB atomic update requires `started_at: {$exists: false}` check.

START_ride_button.behavior: Click 'Démarrer la course' → API returns 200 with status='IN_PROGRESS' → Toast shows 'Course démarrée !' → Badge updates to 'En cours'

END_ride_button.behavior: Click 'Terminer la course' → API returns 200 with status='DRIVER_COMPLETED' → Toast shows 'Course terminée ! Le client a été notifié.' → Badge updates to 'Terminée (attente client)'

409_error_handling.behavior: When course already started/ended, shows appropriate info toast based on current_status field from response

status_badge_updates.transitions: ASSIGNED (Attribuée) → IN_PROGRESS (En cours) → DRIVER_COMPLETED (Terminée attente client)

bug_1_unknown_status_error.original: 'Course déjà en statut: unknown' on iPhone/Safari
bug_1_unknown_status_error.notes: Frontend now correctly reads 'status' field from 200 response and 'current_status' from 409 response

bug_2_email_not_sent.original: Driver assignment email not sent after commission payment
bug_2_email_not_sent.notes: Email sending functionality not in scope for this test - focuses on UI button bugs
